protocol.keystone: Raw centered projective output. NO post-keystone RMS/area rescaling.
protocol.reference: Capture1 zero-gaze centered arithmetic means, demand0.36036036036036034D.
protocol.scale: One positive P1-profiled scalar per frame, shared with P4; no P4 scale.
protocol.metric: Original centered camera mean-three-vertex SSE, equal fixation weights; inverse secondary.
protocol.old_results: Historical read-only comparisons only; no old fitted optics/states used.
protocol.P1_gauge: Four-coefficient exp(a), exp(-a) and generalized projective denominator; identity at zero gaze; no arbitrary isotropic gaze function.
